notes: All 8 volumetric → 45° template. No ketsi/clay pots — Matte Graphite V1/V2 only.

items.subject: Whole Georgian chicken tabaka (tsitsila tabaka): pressed flat whole young chicken, deep golden crispy skin, juicer meat at joints, lightly seasoned, served bone-in on a matte graphite flat plate. No extra sides. Appetizing natural gloss on skin fat, plate stays fully matte.

Georgian chicken chkmeruli: roasted chicken pieces swimming in glossy creamy garlic sauce, visible pepper flakes, generous sauce pooling in a deep matte graphite bowl. Food sauce has realistic specular highlights; bowl is completely matte charcoal. No clay pot.
Slow-stewed beef chunks in a rich brown gravy, fork-tender meat with soft onion, served in a deep matte graphite bowl. Natural juice gloss on the stew surface; bowl fully matte. No rustic clayware.

Georgian plate composition in one deep matte graphite bowl: stewed meat in savory sauce beside a generous scoop of cheesy tashmijabi (Svan mashed potato with cheese), rustic but clean plating, appetizing steam-sheen on food, dishware zero gloss.

Beef khashlama: large pieces of boiled beef with potato, carrot and onion in a clear aromatic broth inside a deep matte graphite bowl. Broth has subtle oily sheen; meat looks tender; bowl stays matte charcoal.

Georgian pork mtsvadi: chunky grilled pork cubes with charred edges and juicy pinkish interior highlights, stacked appetizingly on a matte graphite flat plate. Light oil sheen on meat only. No skewers sticking out of frame, no white plate, no clay pot.

Juicy glazed pork ribs, fall-off-the-bone look, caramelized edges, arranged neatly on a matte graphite flat plate. Natural sticky glaze shine on the meat; plate completely matte. No extra cutlery on the dish.

Whole or large fillet of pan-seared mountain trout with crispy golden skin, served on a matte graphite flat plate with a fresh vegetable salad (tomato, cucumber, herbs) beside the fish. Light oil gloss on fish skin; plate matte; nothing floating outside the plate rim.
